name: Royal Pharmacy
note: Retail pharmacy is the explicit approved-category exception; prior resolution confirms a Kuwait MoH-licensed online pharmacy with home delivery and app. Site 403-blocks bots but the specific prior corroboration holds.

name: Sabsah Hypermarket Co Kuwait
note: Independently fetched: genuine live Kuwait hypermarket e-commerce (Ahmadi/Fintas) with grocery + electronics + appliances catalog, cart and checkout. Grocery is approved/high-frequency; the keyword-only reason holds up on the merits.

name: Safat Home by Alghanim Industries
note: Genuine Kuwait-HQ Alghanim Industries; own storefront with detailed broad home-furnishings catalog, KD pricing and working cart. Home/furniture approved, scale evidenced.

name: Safi
note: 560-result WooCommerce catalog with real pricing/stock flags and confirmed cart/checkout; Kuwait cosmetics (approved, high-repeat). Airtight SKU + cart evidence.

name: Seventh Dimension Company
note: Gate 2: company self-describes as unifying 'smart device distribution, retail, e-commerce' and specializing in 'Retail, Distribution, E-commerce, and Business Solutions' plus a Free-Trade-Zone supply chain -- a real B2B/distribution dimension the original reason omitted. Genuine hybrid-B2B doubt though a real ASTORE retail arm exists.

name: Starco Holding
note: Explicitly named as a Gate 1 PASS example in the rulebook (Kuwait-HQ fashion/F&B franchise conglomerate, retail-clean of hard-excluded divisions).

name: Tatayab
note: Independently confirmed as Kuwait/Gulf's largest perfume-fragrance-beauty store with live store + app and broad assortment (perfume, oud, beauty, hair/body care). Approved, high-repeat; my 'might be home decor' doubt is resolved to perfume.

name: Teeela
note: Independently confirmed genuine Kuwait-based kids toys/fashion e-commerce (Lego/Disney/Funko brands), live site + app, funded ($3.75M pre-Series A). Broad toys/kids assortment, approved; thin original body content backfilled.

name: THE BED SHOP
note: Gate 3: confirmed specialist in beds, mattresses & bedding since 1995 -- a narrow, low-repeat line the rulebook explicitly lists as a confirmed fail (mattresses, long replacement cycle) regardless of e-commerce quality. Original reason was keyword-only and never applied Gate 3.

name: The Sultan Center
note: Well-known major Kuwaiti hypermarket chain (TSC); grocery approved and high-frequency, genuinely Kuwait-HQ.

name: Trafalgar Luxury Group
note: Independently confirmed Kuwait-born luxury retailer; its itsluxury.com store is live with 1400+ watches plus jewellery/accessories and same-day delivery. Broad luxury assortment (jewelry approved), real scale, digital channel confirmed.

name: Trolley Convenience Store
note: Gate 4: site returned 503 and I could not confirm a live transactional store or app; the original pass leans on the chain's 'leading convenience store' reputation, not a confirmed live cart/checkout. Real business but the digital channel is asserted-not-evidenced.

name: UFFF GROUP COMPANY
note: Independently confirmed Kuwait pop-culture multi-category retailer (Funko, apparel, toys, home, stationery, games) with live e-commerce + app + physical stores. Broad B2C assortment despite holding Funko brand rights.

name: Union Trading Co.
note: Gate 2: confirmed 'leading retailer AND distributor' with a wholesale division of 3,000+ B2B customer accounts reaching 90% of consumers. Explicit hybrid B2B/B2C -- the wholesale/distribution side alone disqualifies even with a genuine 17-store retail arm.

name: Wahran Trading Company-Kuwait
note: Gate 2: confirmed 'leading distributor of fragrances and beauty products' with exclusive distribution agreements (Tumi, Mind Games). A distributor/B2B trading company; distribution disqualifies even with owned retail chains, and no confirmed consumer e-commerce cart on the corporate site.

name: Wawan Protein
note: Independently confirmed Kuwait-origin (2011) sports-nutrition/supplements retailer; gowawan.com is the live store (rulebook-blessed domain move) and 50+ branches. Consumable health retail, high-repeat, approved.

name: xcite by alghanim electronics
note: Well-known Kuwait-HQ Alghanim electronics/appliance retailer; broad multi-category catalog with full transactional infrastructure and app. Well beyond the scale floor.

name: Yahaal
note: Gate 5: web.yahaal.com is an app-download landing page with no catalog/cart (mobile-only), and the app shows only ~10K downloads -- below the 50k Gate 5b floor and directly matching the Al Sadhan precedent. No 5a substantiality path exists.

name: Al Jazeera Perfumes
note: Doha, Qatar HQ (est. 1998) confirmed via prior search; custom-built multi-region live e-commerce with physical Qatar retail. Perfume approved (consumable/repeat); detailed prior verification holds.

name: Al Meera Consumer Goods Company
note: Qatar's largest homegrown supermarket/hypermarket chain, Qatar Exchange-listed; grocery approved, Qatar-HQ, massive scale. Duplicate of the almeera.com.qa row (#26) -- should be consolidated per Gate 6, but the company itself qualifies.

name: Al Rawabi Group of Companies
note: This row's domain is the Rawabi Hypermarket storefront -- independently confirmed live transactional grocery e-commerce (thousands of SKUs, cart, QAR pricing, 8 Qatar stores, delivery slots). Gate 6 allows the retail-qualifying subsidiary to pass on its own merits even though the parent group is mixed.

name: Al Rawabi Group of Companies W.L.L
note: Gate 6 + Gate 4: this is the parent corporate/holding site of a conglomerate that mixes retail with wholesale (Rawabi Food International, Emdadco, Wholesale Plus), food manufacturing, distribution and hospitality. Mixed-conglomerate parent is excluded (only the hypermarket subsidiary, row #21, qualifies), and a holding page is not itself a storefront.

name: Al Shaheen Est
note: Independently confirmed Doha-founded (1988) broad general-merchandise retailer (household, electronics, toys, furniture, cosmetics) with physical showrooms + live online shop. The prior OUT/'diversified_trading' call was wrong; it is genuine consumer retail.

name: Al Sulaiman Jewellers
note: Independently confirmed Doha, Qatar HQ (since 1993); gold/diamond jewelry (approved, broad) across 15 Qatar showrooms with a live store. Geography confirmed as Qatar, not the separate Saudi Al Sulaiman.

name: AlaneesQatar
note: Independently confirmed Qatar-founded (1992) and Doha-HQ'd, not a UAE branch; broad consumer-electronics retailer with 16+ Qatar stores and live e-commerce + app. Geography and category hold.

name: ALMEERA CONSUMER GOODS COMPANY QSC
note: Al Meera Q.P.S.C., Doha-HQ, Qatar Exchange-listed grocery giant with app, scheduled delivery and 50-65+ branches; grocery approved, massive scale. Same company as row #20.

name: Ansar Gallery
note: Independently confirmed Ansar Group HQ in Doha, Qatar (est. 1980/1987); UAE was later expansion, not origin. Full-scale live hypermarket/general-merchandise e-commerce with broad approved assortment.

name: BaladiMart
note: Al Baladi Holding (Doha, Qatar) first-party grocery/hypermarket operator; prior verification cited 150k products, native iOS/Android apps and independent news corroboration per the Gate 4 blocked-site protocol. Site 503s to direct fetch, but the corroboration is methodologically sound and grocery is approved.

name: Beauty Booth Qatar
note: Independently confirmed Doha, Qatar HQ; genuine beauty/cosmetics e-commerce (skincare, haircare, makeup, fragrance, baby care). Geography and category hold; the keyword-only reason is correct on the merits.

name: Blue Salon
note: Well-known Qatari luxury department store (a Doha institution, not a hair salon); broad fashion/accessories/jewelry/fragrance catalog with QAR pricing, cart and app. Qatar-HQ, approved.

name: BTC Fashion
note: Doha-HQ fashion retail arm of Qatar's Business Trading Company (est. 1997); bFab is BTC's OWN e-commerce platform (not a third-party marketplace) selling its franchise brands (Matalan, Superdry, Miniso). Approved fashion, own live channel. Uses WebEngage -- already-solved soft signal, deprioritize not exclude.

name: Care n Cure Group
note: Doha, Qatar founded/HQ'd (est. 2000); retail pharmacy (approved exception) with 65 outlets and live e-commerce cart/checkout. Airtight per specific prior evidence.
